name: Forget-Me-Not
source:
Emmett used to be extremely withdrawn and hated socializing. Michael had just moved into his neighborhood and wanted somebody to talk to. In a short, strange course of events, they met on a rooftop and talked for a little while. Emmett soon grew attached to the complete stranger, opening up and may have even considered him a friend. However, the summer friendship ended when Michael moved away, but that left Emmett with a problem he realized he could overcome.

The dreamlike memory of the boy became so blurred to him, that when the same boy transfers into his homeroom sophomore year, he doesn’t recognize him at first! They rekindle their friendship to a point where they become close friends…to something a little more than friends.

Emmett feels content with the way things have gone for them, but he can’t ignore the strange feeling in his gut that’s telling him something isn’t right with Michael. There are still things he doesn’t know about Michael, even coming so far in their relationship. What isn’t Michael telling him?

[From [url=https://boniae.itch.io/forget-me-not]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃米特曾经极度封闭，讨厌与人交往。迈克尔刚搬到他家附近，想找个人聊天。在一连串短暂而奇怪的经历中，两人在屋顶相遇并聊了一会儿。

埃米特很快对这个完全陌生的人产生了依恋，敞开心扉，甚至可能把他当成了朋友。然而，迈克尔搬走后，这段夏日友情结束了，却也给埃米特留下了一个他意识到自己能够克服的问题。

那个男孩的梦幻般记忆在他脑中变得如此模糊，以至于同一个男孩在他高中二年级时转入自己的班级，他一开始竟没认出对方！

两人重新建立起友谊，关系逐渐亲密，最终成为亲密朋友……甚至超越了朋友。

埃米特对两人的关系感到满足，但他无法忽略内心深处那个告诉他迈克尔有些不对劲的奇怪感觉。即使两人的关系已经发展到这一步，他仍然不知道迈克尔的一些事情。

迈克尔究竟隐瞒了什么？
